summaryPolicy: News facts remain unmodified, cleaned publisher/RSS excerpts. The display layer translates only those stored source fragments and records their hash; it never generates a summary. If translation is unavailable or fails quality checks, it displays the original language.
displayPolicy: Only records verified against their stored publisher headline and RSS snippet are shown in the main feed. Rule-based interpretation is separately labelled and never treated as a source fact.
excludedTermsReason: Configured product-scope exclusion for this dashboard. The rule is applied at collection time; existing records remain in the cumulative history ledger.
